title: Small wording fix plus its test
goal: The terminal UI's run hint (`runHint` in packages/cli/src/tui/layout.ts) reads 'paused for Merge all: /handoff merge' while a merge of the whole run is paused. 'Merge all' is a VS Code button that the terminal UI does not have. Change that longest form of the hint to 'merging paused: /handoff merge', leaving the two shorter forms as they are, and update the tests that assert the old text (packages/cli/src/tui/__tests__/opsTasks.test.ts and packages/cli/src/tui/__tests__/render.test.ts, including the test title that mentions it). The cli package's tests must pass.

keepTogether.description: The wording change and the tests that assert it, in one task.

integrationRisks: Splitting the string change from its tests, so one task leaves the suite red.
Research tasks or a review task added to a one-line change.
key.expectedStrategy: Exactly one task that edits layout.ts and both test files.
